logline: An alien stranded on Earth for 400 years falls for a top actress just as a conspiracy threatens both their lives, forcing him to choose between love and survival.

renewal.note: Single-season run of 21 episodes completed on February 27, 2014. No sequel was produced. The series sparked the Korean Wave internationally and won the Magnolia Award for Best Foreign Television Series at the 2014 Shanghai International Film Festival.

bollymeter.basis: One of the defining K-dramas of the 2010s - it averaged 24% national viewership, swept the Baeksang Arts Awards, and earned a 9/10 from The Drama Corner for its deft blend of romance, comedy, and fantasy without losing momentum.

A fast and funny drama with one of the most lovable heroines of dramaland.

seasons.review_body: Premiering December 18, 2013, My Love from the Star averaged 24 percent nationwide viewership in South Korea and became a genuine pan-Asian cultural event, crashing servers hosting international streams. Critics at The Drama Corner scored it 9 out of 10, praising the series for sustaining romantic and comedic energy across 21 episodes without the customary late-stretch sag. Kim Soo-hyun's alien Do Min-joon and Jun Ji-hyun's chaotic star Cheon Song-yi generated audience consensus that their chemistry was among the finest pairing in the genre's history. The show collected three wins at the Baeksang Arts Awards and the Magnolia Award for Best Foreign Television Series in 2014, cementing it as the flagship Korean drama that carried the Korean Wave to new markets.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 1
episode_reviews.review_body: My Love from the Star Season 1 Episode 1 aired December 18, 2013 on SBS as the premiere of a drama that averaged 24 percent nationwide viewership, swept the Baeksang Arts Awards, and won the Magnolia Award for Best Foreign Television Series at the 2014 Shanghai International Film Festival. IMDb audiences scored the series 8.2. The Drama Corner scored the series 9 out of 10 for sustaining its genre-blend energy across 21 episodes. The premiere establishes Do Min-joon's 400 years of Earth residency and engineers his collision with Cheon Song-yi with a tonal range that signals the show's formal ambition: historical prologue, present-day celebrity satire, and a genuine romantic undertow are all present from the first episode. Kim Soo-hyun and Jun Ji-hyun's chemistry, cited by critics as among the finest pairing in the genre's history, is established from their first shared scene.
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The premiere establishes Do Min-joon's 400 years of solitary Earth residency and engineers his collision with Cheon Song-yi. The tonal range is established immediately - historical prologue, present-day celebrity satire, and a genuine romantic undertow - signalling a show with more formal ambition than its rom-com packaging suggests.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Min-joon saves Song-yi from a speeding car, the first of many interventions he swore he would never make.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 21
episode_reviews.review_body: My Love from the Star Season 1 Episode 21 aired February 27, 2014 on SBS as the finale of a 21-episode drama that averaged 24 percent nationwide viewership and became a pan-Asian cultural event. IMDb audiences scored the series 8.2. The Drama Corner called it 'an exhilarating drama that deftly mixes romance, comedy, thrills and fantasy into one enjoyable ride.' The finale resolves the central emotional argument the series had been staging across 21 episodes: whether an immortal who has chosen 400 years of distance can commit to a mortal love knowing the structural cost. The resolution became one of the most-discussed K-drama endings of the early 2010s, cited as a template for how the genre handles the immortal-mortal romance convention. The farewell scene between Min-joon and Song-yi, structured around what is left unsaid, is the episode's primary legacy.
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The finale resolves the season's central emotional argument: whether an immortal who has chosen distance can commit to a mortal love knowing the cost. Critics and audiences converged on the ending as one of the most emotionally earned conclusions in the K-drama canon at that time.
episode_reviews.the_moment: The farewell scene between Min-joon and Song-yi, structured around what is left unsaid as much as the declaration itself.
